_comment: NEGATIVE FIXTURE N12 — event with zero qualified object references (E2O_EMPTY). OCPQ Def.2 requires every event to qualify-reference >=1 object; an event with no object evidence is an 'activity-only fake' move (maps to AndonPull::ActivityOnlyFakeRoute at the route gate). Minimal counterexample: add one E2O relationship to e2 and the log validates.
